title: Setkage (staff)
body:
Syntax: setkage <player>  |  setkage <player> remove

Description: Appoints a player as their village's Kage -- the one rank in the game that's never reachable through the normal level/mission-based promotion ladder. Intended for someone voted in by their own community; the vote itself happens outside the game, but only an Implementor can make it official. The target must already be a Village Elder. At most one Kage per village at a time -- appointing a new one automatically relieves whoever held it before, back to Village Elder. 'setkage <player> remove' relieves the current Kage without appointing a replacement.

&D(Staff only -- requires Implementor access.)&x

Date: 2026-08-17
